title: OmniScopeR: A Causality-Integrated Visualization Framework for Multi-Omics Data
text: OmniScopeR — causality-aware visualization framework multi-omics integration exploration.
code: library(OmniScopeR)  # Example data df1 <- data.frame(gene1 = rnorm(10), gene2 = rnorm(10)) df2 <- data.frame(met1 = rnorm(10), met2 = rnorm(10)) rownames(df1) <- rownames(df2) <- paste0("Sample", 1:10)  omics <- omni_integrate(df1, df2) graph <- omni_causal(omics) omni_visualize(graph) importance <- omni_explain(omics, phenotype = rnorm(10)) omni_narrate(omics, graph, importance) #> OmniScopeR Report #> ================= #> Samples: 10 #> Features: 4 #>  #> Top Important Features: #> gene2, gene1, met2, met1 #>  #> Causal Graph Density: 0
